meta.title: Custom device skins — design your own
meta.description: Design a custom skin for your phone, tablet or laptop. Pick a pattern, tune the colours, add your name or artwork and see a live preview before you request it.

hero.title: Make your device unmistakably yours
hero.subtitle: Pick a design, remix the colours, add a monogram or your own artwork — and watch it come alive on your exact model.

how.title: How it works
how.s1Body: Choose your device and a design, then make it yours with colours, text and finish.
how.s2Body: Our team checks feasibility for your model and shares a final price. No payment now.
how.s3Body: Accept the price and we prepare your skin, then fit it or hand it over.

gallery.title: Design catalogue
gallery.subtitle: Every design is a starting point — remix the palette in the studio.
gallery.empty: No designs in this collection yet.

device.title: Which device are we designing for?
device.hint: Skins are cut for your exact model. Phones, tablets and laptops are supported.

design.title: Start from a design
design.blankBody: Solid colours, your text or your own artwork.

artwork.title: Your artwork (optional)
artwork.body: Upload a photo, logo or illustration (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB). It stays private — only you and our design team can see it.
artwork.rights: Only upload images you own or have permission to use.

review.notesPlaceholder: e.g. leave the logo cut-out visible
review.acceptTerms: I understand this is a design request, not an order. The team will confirm feasibility and the final price before anything is made.
review.signInNotice: Sign in or create an account to send your design. Your design is saved while you sign in.

price.estimateNote: Indicative only — the final price is confirmed by our team after review. No payment is taken now.

done.title: Your design is on its way to our studio
done.body: Reference {reference}. We'll review feasibility for your model and share a final price. You'll be notified at each step.

preview.label: Preview of the custom design on {device}
preview.illustrative: Illustrative preview — final colours may vary slightly by material.

validation.acceptTerms: Please confirm you understand how design requests work.
validation.unavailable: This option is no longer available. Please choose another.
validation.artwork: That artwork upload is not available. Please upload it again.
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
validation.slugTaken: That slug is already in use.

errors.quoteNotActionable: This price can no longer be accepted or declined.

account.title: Custom designs
account.empty: You haven't sent any design requests yet.
account.needsInfoTitle: We need a bit more information
account.quoteBody: Our team has reviewed your design and set the price below.
account.acceptBody: We'll start preparing your design at {price}. Our team will contact you about payment and handover.
account.declineBody: Nothing will be made. You can tell us why (optional).
account.accepted: Accepted — we'll be in touch about next steps.
account.cancelBody: You can cancel until a price is shared. This cannot be undone.
account.declinedTitle: We couldn't take this design on
